briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 race intensifies as China deploys DeepSeek-R2 at scale

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 major models this month amid $14.2B in quarterly funding. US-China chip restrictions tighten while multi-agent systems show rapid capability jumps. Prompt injection attacks continue rising in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview with advanced tool use; xAI released Grok-4; DeepSeek-R2 matches GPT-4o performance at lower cost. Meta's Llama 4.1 open weights spark new fine-tuning wave.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; Google TPU v6 clusters online in Iowa. Microsoft and CoreWeave announce $9B joint data center expansion.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10-trillion-parameter model be Chinese or American by end of 2027?
